title: Pricing Basis: the Price a Vacation Package Carries Once Places Are Given Up
content:
The price a package carries is re-worked when places on it are given up. What follows defines the quantities that re-working is built from, for any of the Vacation Package Products, and the order in which they are brought together.

The per-place price is the quoted package price divided by the adults and the children shown on the package record, counted together.

The places given up are taken as one, and the places retained are the adults and the children shown on the package record, counted together, less the places given up.

The places price is the per-place price multiplied by the places retained.

The occupancy adjustment carried into the revised price is nil.

The charges already withheld against the package are not carried into the revised price.

The club rate applied to the priced places is the whole of them and nothing more.

The re-pricing rate applied to the priced places is the whole of them and nothing more.

## The order of working

The revised price is worked out in one order: the places price and the occupancy adjustment are first added together, that sum is then reduced by the club rate — which is to say the sum is taken at that rate — the result of that step is then taken at the re-pricing rate, and the charges carried in are added last. The figure is rounded to two decimal places only at the end and is never less than nil. No rounding falls at any earlier step, and the charges carried in are added after the two rates have acted and never before.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

Take a package on the Luxury Collection Package whose record shows 3 adults and 1 child travelling and a quoted price of 6,000.00 USD.

The adults and children counted together number 4, so the per-place price is 1,500.00 USD. The places given up are taken as one, so the places retained number 3, and the places price is 4,500.00 USD. The occupancy adjustment is nil, so the sum of the two is 4,500.00 USD. The club rate is the whole of that sum, leaving 4,500.00 USD; the re-pricing rate is the whole of it again, leaving 4,500.00 USD; and no charges are carried in. The figure is above nil, and rounded to two decimal places the revised price is 4,500.00 USD.
